items.html: And know that this is only at the beginning of Atzilut. However, after the Mochin of pregnancy, nursing, and Gadlut have already first entered him, even though afterward, due to the blemish of the lower ones, ZA returns to the aspect of the first pregnancy, as at the time of the exile of Egypt and at the time of the destruction of the Holy Temple, woe to us — still, the aspect of the nursing is not removed from him. Rather, the entire Name of Elokim remains there, only that the letters Yod-Hei of Elokim do not reveal their light. And they sit sealed there, and only the letters Aleph-Lamed-Mem are revealed.
